name: get_product_reviews
description: Retrieves customer reviews for a specific product on Carrefour France, identified by its EAN/GTIN. Returns the total review count and a paginated list of reviews. Supports sorting by field and order, and limiting the number of reviews returned.

ean.description: The EAN/GTIN barcode of the product to retrieve reviews for

limit.description: Maximum number of reviews to return

sortOrder.description: Sort order: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending
